rules.title: Bill H.3744: special law authorizing Boston to implement rent stabilization
rules.requirement: Home-rule petition (193rd General Court) asking the Legislature to authorize the City of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections. The passage shows only referral, a hearing and extensions of the committee reporting date. It shows no enactment and states no cap or formula.

coverage.summary: Would authorize Boston only; no coverage terms stated in the passage.

rules.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.review_note: The action list is truncated, so the final outcome is not shown. Status is pending because no passage or enactment is shown. The session may have ended, which could make it failed.

rules.title: Initiative Petition 25-21: An Initiative Petition to Protect Tenants by Limiting Rent Increases
rules.requirement: Statewide initiative that would strike G.L. c. 40P (the statewide prohibition on rent control) and replace it with a limit on any annual rent increase tied to the CPI or a percentage figure. The Supreme Judicial Court opinion concludes art. 48 bars placement of the petition on the November 2026 ballot.
rules.key_value: Annual rent increase limit at CPI increase or [five percent] (text truncated)

coverage.summary: Statewide petition; it contains an exemption for religious facilities, which is why the court excluded it from the ballot.

rules.exemptions: Includes an exemption for facilities operated solely for religious purposes.
rules.quoted_span: Accordingly, art. 48 bars placement of the petition on the November 2026 Statewide election ballot.
rules.review_note: The passage is a truncated mirror of an opinion; the CPI/5% limit text is cut off.
rules.source_notes: Secondary full-text mirror of the court opinion.
